title: Reducing Inference Cost of Coding Agents with Timeout Cascades
abstract: arXiv:2611.24324v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI coding agents have become one of the most popular applications of large language models. Yet, agentic AI comes at the cost of a tremendous amount of GPU compute resources, which limits its profitability and its viability at scale. In this paper, we investigate whether smaller, cheaper models can cut this cost without sacrificing accuracy.   We evaluate 36 popular large and small open-weight models released since 2024 on a software engineering benchmark, and find that recent small models are closing the accuracy gap compared to their large counterparts. We investigate the structure of this gap and find that the gap is highly concentrated around hard tasks that small language models fail to solve while achieving remarkably good accuracy for easy and medium complexity tasks. translated_title: 使用超时级联降低编码智能体的推理成本
translated_abstract: AI编码智能体已成为大语言模型最流行的应用之一。然而，智能体式AI的运行需要消耗大量GPU计算资源，这限制了其盈利能力和规模化部署的可行性。在本文中，我们研究了更小、更便宜的模型能否在不牺牲准确性的前提下降低这一成本。我们在一个软件工程基准测试上评估了自2024年以来发布的36个流行的大型和小型开源权重模型，发现近期的小模型正在缩小与大型模型之间的准确性差距。我们进一步研究了这一差距的结构，发现差距高度集中在小语言模型无法解决的困难任务上，而对于简单和中等复杂度的任务，小模型能够取得非常好的准确性。基于这一观察，我们展示了通过采用混合推理策略——先尝试小模型，仅在需要时才升级到大模型——我们可以大幅降低推理成本。（注：原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出一种超时级联的混合推理策略，先让小模型尝试解决任务、必要时再升级到大模型，从而在不牺牲准确率的前提下大幅降低AI编码智能体的推理成本。
en_tdlr: A timeout-cascade hybrid inference strategy—trying a small model first and escalating to a larger one only when needed—can substantially reduce the inference cost of AI coding agents without sacrificing accuracy.
